subject.title: fix(doctor): bound legacy session store read with size cap and stat-failure fix

question: Should Doctor preserve migration for valid legacy session stores above 50 MiB, or intentionally make them unreadable to enforce a resource cap?
rationale: Current main accepts those stores, while the branch intentionally changes that migration outcome; choosing an upgrade contract is a maintainer product and compatibility decision.

options.title: Preserve existing migration compatibility
options.body: Remove the new absolute rejection while retaining descriptor-bound validation and an exact validated-size read.

options.title: Adopt the 50 MiB migration limit
options.body: Keep the cap only with explicit upgrade behavior, user-facing documentation, and an accepted policy that larger valid legacy stores require a supported recovery path.

recommendation.title: Preserve existing migration compatibility
recommendation.body: Remove the new absolute rejection while retaining descriptor-bound validation and an exact validated-size read.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the proposed compatibility-changing implementation and can clarify its intended contract while an area owner confirms the final policy.
